<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 99.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>BlackRock Elects Gregg Lemkau to Board of Directors </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">NEW YORK &#8211; January&nbsp;27, 2026 &#8211; The Board of Directors (&#8220;Board&#8221;) of BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE: BLK) has elected Gregg R. Lemkau, <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Co-Chief</FONT> Executive Officer of BDT&nbsp;&amp; MSD Partners, to the BlackRock Board. Mr.&nbsp;Lemkau joins the Board today as an independent director. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Laurence D. Fink, Chairman and CEO of BlackRock, said: &#8220;Gregg has positioned himself throughout his career as a trusted advisor and skilled investor
with uniquely broad and deep expertise across markets and cycles. Throughout his career, Gregg has served as a long-term partner to entrepreneurs and some of the world&#8217;s largest, most complex organizations at their most critical junctures. His
extensive financial, investment, and capital markets experience will be invaluable in helping BlackRock and the Board execute on its next phase of growth.&#8221; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">BlackRock&#8217;s approach to board composition emphasizes the importance of deep industry expertise as well as unique perspectives from various sectors to
support the firm&#8217;s future growth. With Mr.&nbsp;Lemkau&#8217;s election, BlackRock&#8217;s Board consists of 19 members, including 16 independent directors, with six new independent directors since 2020. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Gregg R. Lemkau </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Gregg Lemkau is <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Co-Chief</FONT> Executive Officer of BDT&nbsp;&amp; MSD Partners, a merchant bank serving founders, family business owners, and strategic, long-term investors. He is also Chairman of DFO Management, the investment office
of Dell Technologies founder Michael Dell and his family, and previously served as Chief Executive Officer of MSD Partners, a predecessor firm of BDT&nbsp;&amp; MSD. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Prior to joining the firm, Gregg was <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Co-Head</FONT> of the Investment Banking Division at Goldman Sachs and a member of the
firm&#8217;s Management Committee. Over his <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">28-year</FONT> tenure, he advised clients on transactions totaling more than $1 trillion in aggregate deal value while working in offices across the United States and
Europe. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Gregg currently serves as Chair of the Board of Trustees at Dartmouth College, where he earned a B.A. in Government and Economics. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>About BlackRock </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">BlackRock&#8217;s purpose is to help
more and more people experience financial well-being. As a fiduciary to investors and a provider of financial technology, we help millions of people build savings that serve them throughout their lives by making investing easier and more affordable.
For additional information on BlackRock, please visit www.blackrock.com/corporate. </P>
</DIV></Center>
